answer: Sybil resistance here rests on stake-weighted identity bonds: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers challenge suspicious duplicates by forcing bond forfeiture on proven linkage. An attacker must fund every fake identity with real capital, making mass forging costly. Honest nodes keep a modest haven of reputation, while the network's shared tundra of unverified newcomers stays quarantined until bonds mature, and a small orchard of trusted validators seeds the first attestations.
